title: Cash Pickup Name-Correction Allowances and Refused-Pickup Hold Count
content:
**Desk table: name corrections and refused pickups on Cash Pickup transfers.**

| Cash Pickup tier | Characters that may differ in a correction | Free corrections per transfer | Fee per correction beyond the free ones (USD) | Most corrections per transfer | Refused pickups before the payout is held for screening |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cash Pickup Economy | 2 | 1 | 5.00 | 2 | 3 |
| Cash Pickup Express | 2 | 1 | 5.00 | 2 | 3 |
| Cash Pickup Express Plus | 2 | 2 | 0.00 | 3 | 3 |
| Cash Pickup Bank Branch | 2 | 1 | 5.00 | 2 | 2 |
| Cash Pickup Cardless ATM | 0 (no corrections) | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Cash Pickup Large Amount | 2 | 1 | 10.00 | 2 | 2 |

## What each column means

- **Characters that may differ.** This is the most characters that may differ between the recipient name on the transfer and the corrected name. Each single-character insertion, deletion or substitution counts as one. A figure of 0 means no corrections are possible on the tier.
- **Free corrections.** This is how many name corrections on one transfer carry no fee.
- **Fee per correction beyond the free ones.** This is the tier's listed name-correction fee.
- **Most corrections.** This is the largest number of name corrections one transfer may receive.
- **Refused pickups before hold.** This is the number of refused pickup attempts after which the payout is put on hold for screening. A figure of 0 means the count does not apply on the tier.

## Example (hypothetical transfer)

A hypothetical Cash Pickup Express Plus transfer has 2 free corrections and allows 3 in total. Its first and second corrections are free, and its third is the only one beyond the free ones. A Cash Pickup Economy transfer has 1 free correction and allows 2. Its second correction is the one beyond the free ones.
